# Migraine Headache Tracker Log

> Migraine Headache Tracker Log is a headache tracker app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Log a migraine in one tap with Health, weather and pressure added. Private.

## App

- [Headache Tracker App | Migraine Headache Tracker Log](https://jackwallner.com/ios/headaches/index.html.md): Migraine Headache Tracker Log is a headache tracker app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Log a migraine in one tap with Health, weather and pressure added. Private.

## Guides

- [Barometric Pressure Headaches: What Studies Show and How to Track Them](https://jackwallner.com/ios/headaches/barometric-pressure-headaches.html.md): Barometric pressure headaches explained: what studies of pressure drops and migraine found, why not everyone reacts, and how to log pressure with each headache.
- [Best Headache Tracker App for iPhone (2026 Comparison)](https://jackwallner.com/ios/headaches/best-headache-tracker-app.html.md): Five iPhone headache and migraine tracker apps compared: Migraine Buddy, MiG, Pressure Pal, Relief and Migraine Headache Tracker Log. Facts as of October 2026.
- [How to Keep a Headache Diary: What to Log and What to Skip](https://jackwallner.com/ios/headaches/how-to-keep-a-headache-diary.html.md): How to keep a headache diary: the five fields to log every time, optional context worth adding, a sample entry, and when to bring it to a doctor.
- [Migraine Trigger Tracking: How to Find Your Triggers With a Diary](https://jackwallner.com/ios/headaches/migraine-trigger-tracking.html.md): How to track migraine triggers: the most common triggers, what to log before each attack, how long it takes, and how to tell an early symptom from a trigger.

## Optional

- [One Tap Headache Tracker for Android Privacy Policy](https://jackwallner.github.io/headaches/android-privacy.html.md): One Tap Headache Tracker for Android keeps your headache log on your phone. It reads sleep from Health Connect and weather from Open-Meteo only with your permission, and needs no account.
